title: Per-feature receipts lack authorship needed by the attestation re-point
context: Issue #468 Phase B change map re-points attestationEvents (SIEM), collectAttestation, latestReceiptAuthorship and latestReceiptTrustExtras to per-feature bundle receipts. But projectFeatureReceipt is called in run-repository-verification.ts WITHOUT authorship/compliance/reproducibility, so per-feature receipts carry no authorship (only the retired whole-project receipt does). The frozen spec INV-1/INV-3 said no writer is modified and the spine file is untouched. Two ways forward.

options.label: Extend projectFeatureReceipt (additive) + pass the already-computed authorship/compliance/reproducibility from the caller so per-feature receipts are complete; re-point all attestation readers now
Keep collectAttestation/attestationEvents/latestReceipt* on the still-written whole-project chain in Phase B; re-point them in Phase C alongside the writer cutover

rationale: Per-feature receipt must be complete for the attestation re-point the issue mandates; additive field extension + pass caller-computed values, surgical spine touch, re-freeze spec.
